key_insight: Human and LLM recipe-writing performed similarly in materials synthesis, and their closed-loop collaboration helped discover a new crystal structure, Ba3PtO5.
engineering_relevance: The study shows that pairing LLMs with experimental feedback can accelerate materials synthesis planning and discovery, especially in well-defined but underexplored chemical spaces.
method: Generate synthesis recipes with humans and LLMs for known and unknown materials
Test recipes in the lab and feed outcomes back into the next round
Focus on the Ruddlesden-Popper-related composition space to compare success rates
evidence_signal: The abstract reports round-by-round synthesis success rates for humans versus LLMs on known and unknown targets, plus the discovery of Ba3PtO5 as a new prototype.
watch_item: Success drops sharply for unknown materials, so lab validation and careful human oversight remain essential before trusting LLM-generated synthesis routes.
paper_title: Human and LLM Collaboration for Accelerated Materials Synthesis and Discovery
